subject: Windows Dolphins Sample Example missing necessary objects?

messages.author: 169b324dc4378324
messages.subject: Windows Dolphins Sample Example missing necessary objects?
parts:
Hi,

I downloaded and installed Distance for Windows 7.3 R2 today and am now trying to understand more on dsm analysis with the Windows Dolphins sample project.

Appears R objects (e.g. “ddf.3”) required to run Windows “Dolphins” dsm analysis example are not available / not being imported. The first four models in the Dolphins example run, but the “dsm x+ y” fails to run. Copy of the error log below.

Not sure if this is right place to post but would be good if someone could confirm so I know it is not just an isolated issue (I have tried switch on switch off and uninstall / install and the same problem persists).

Any suggestions to get the Windows Dolphins sample example running much appreciated.

Many thanks,

Darren

messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Windows Dolphins Sample Example missing necessary objects?
parts:
Darren

Thanks for your question, this is the right place to raise it.

Your diagnosis that "ddf.3" is the cause of the error you received when trying to fit the dsm model "x+y".  The remedy however is not to have "ddf.3" shipped with the software, but rather to have that object preserved after it has been created by analysis 3 ("detection fn - Hazard rate").

Conducting analysis 5 (dsm x+y) is dependent upon the existence of the result produced in analysis 3 (ddf.3).  The Distance for Windows software will tidy after itself, by removing R objects created in previous analysis steps, unless you request that those objects not be tidied.

The solution is to open the Distance Preferences Window, the R Options tab (seen below).  Make sure neither of the two boxes circled are ticked.  This will preserve previous R objects (such as "ddf.3") so they are available in subsequent analysis steps.


Let us know if this solves your problem.
